verification.diagnostic_boundary: All declared independent driver ranges are inspected without changing any source law or gate. A witness proves incompatibility of exact equality projection with the declared bound at that driver value. MuJoCo source equality/limit dynamics are compliant; these witnesses do not prove those soft dynamics infeasible. FP32 native checks round source-projected coordinates against consumed range bytes, not native polynomial execution. Numerical stationary points do not constitute interval-arithmetic proof or clinical joint-range calibration.
